implementationLimits: Reserve lane clearance before placing architecture and optional clutter, without widening the final safehouse entry.
Keep cover at pocket edges and leave two readable entrances for each fighting space.
Use quiet road markings that follow real walkable lanes; do not paint routes through collision.
Compare reachable checkpoints, route width and voxel/page/group budgets across all three legs and representative seeds.
Verify ordinary-input travel and same-seed visuals before publishing.
